title: Clean Simulation with Tape Erasure
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes and state set $S$, and choose states $q_1,q\in S$, a Boolean input word $V$, a time $T$, and a natural number $s$. Assume that $M$, started in state $q$ on $V$, has halted at time $T$, and that by time $T$ the set of cells visited by the head of each work tape has cardinality at most $s$. Then the cleaning machine started in its initialization state carrying $q$ on input $V$ eventually halts with the same output as $M$ at time $T$, with all its work-tape cells blank and all its work-tape heads at the origin; throughout this run, every work-tape head has absolute position at most $s$.
hypotheses_covered: machine M with k Boolean work tapes and state set S
natural time T and bound s
M started from its initial configuration in state q halts at T
each original work-tape head visits at most s distinct cells through time T
